title: Cr-Ni: one-shot to step-4 pick step4c-b (hinge floor) - 1.0.2 (10a kink rule, 10c; evaluated states corrected)

snapshot.note: 1.0.2 review snapshot: the frozen 1.0.0 snapshot with the evaluated states of evidence bundle 1.1.0 (ZPF vertices converted to x(Ni); exclusion tiers as the fit read them). Frozen 1.0.0 review snapshot of the step-4 pick step4c-b after the 10a kink-rule re-checks and the 10c global search (6 Nov 2026 evening).

status_banner: 1.0.2 (draft until PI approval): evaluated states corrected (bundle 1.1.0); pick, data and objective unchanged. 424 of 695 states match the calculated assemblage (bundle 1.0.0: 404, with 130 ZPF states given in x(Cr) placed at x(Ni) = x(Cr)). Pick unchanged: step 4c-b s4, CrNi2 top 860 K (ORCHID 863 K), eutectic 1614 K (1618 K). 10a with the kink rule: step 3b pick s1 (kink-stationary) = the start TDB; step 4c-b 8/8 smooth on two machines. 10c basin hopping and dual annealing (1500 evaluations each): no better optimum. Notes as in 0.2.0-draft.

decisions.source: crni-phaseforge-20261105 PLAN.md "PI ruling on references (5 Nov)"

decisions.decision: ordered fcc cells computed for the record; then disordered FCC_A1 only (6 Nov)
decisions.why: CrNi2 is the real ordered phase; no evidence for a partitioned L1_2

decisions.decision: bcc and fcc SQS over the whole composition range
decisions.why: each RK fit extrapolated over half the range

decisions.decision: "held" never means fixed: CRNI2 free in step 3b and 4, anchored by its one-shot HM_FORM at sigma 9.7 kJ
decisions.why: step 3a with CRNI2 fixed left it stable above the liquidus

decisions.decision: step-2 pick s7_perturbed instead of the ranker's s2_perturbed
decisions.why: s2 not converged (|g| 0.011); the ranker's choice rested on a 1-temperature grid difference

decisions.decision: excess electronic entropy of the liquid taken as zero (assumption)
decisions.why: metallic liquid

decisions.decision: single-reader records (Curie marks; CrNi2 at 863 K) may enter the fit labelled; a second reading before release
decisions.why: avoid blocking the fit

decisions.decision: test the ZPF driving-force sigma from each record's sigma_T on Cr-Ni only (one measured change)
decisions.why: CrNi2 83 K miss attributed to the default 1000 J/mol scale
decisions.source: REPORT.md open decision 1; memory exclusions-required-held-free item 3

decisions.decision: step-4 pick = s1_perturbed (main mode; logpost -6332.2437; 4 of 8 starts)
decisions.why: protocol 0.3 ranking of evaluate.py; the higher-objective modes were absent in the original run; under fit_protocol 10a the same mode is picked (5 eligible starts)

decisions.decision: step-4 pick = step4c-b (step4c_b_hingefloor, start s4_perturbed); the hinge floor sigma = max(tier, converted state uncertainty) adopted as a protocol rule
decisions.why: 0 of 8 starts stationary without the floor (step4c), 8 of 8 with it, one mode, CrNi2 860 K vs 863 K observed
decisions.source: coordinator message 6 Nov 2026; fit_protocol item 8 (commit bef0bae)

decisions.decision: per-record ZPF scale sigma_DF floored at the tier, smooth hinge onset (sigma/5), kinetically limited absences (CrNi2 suspended at short-anneal states)
decisions.why: Cr-Ni test: one mode in 8 of 8 starts, phase-boundary misfit halved, thermochemistry unchanged

decisions.decision: 10a accepts kink-stationary endpoints; central FD is not a gradient; failed equilibria are failures
decisions.why: local kinks are inevitable (data points on model phase boundaries)

decisions.decision: step 3b not refitted: its 10a pick (s1, kink-stationary) is the TDB step 4c-b started from
decisions.why: pick identical on the original starts and on spark1; the Studio-polished s1 differs only in flat directions and step 4 reaches the same optimum from either step-3b pick (Q36)

decisions.decision: 10c adaptations: box z in [-5, 5] around s4 in the multistart scaling, L-BFGS-B local solver with <= 50 evaluations per solve, liquid convexity 600-2200 K as feasibility, objective -logpost, global runs launched from s4 before the 10a re-check of step 4c-b had finished on spark1 (the coordinator Studio check had already picked s4)
decisions.why: Cu-Zr scaled box; same local solver as the multistart; physics.py liquid check

decisions.decision: pick kept at s4 although the dual-annealing best is 5e-12 log-units higher
decisions.why: the two points are 3.6e-5 J/mol apart (rounding level; 10b tolerances 50 J/mol, 0.03 J/mol/K), both smooth under 10a; keeping s4 leaves the artifact TDB byte-identical

decisions.decision: version 1.0.0 frozen with status draft (approval is the PI's)
decisions.why: schema status approved means PI approval

decisions.decision: new specific protocol id crni-paper-fit-step4c-b (version 0.2.0-draft, supersedes crni-paper-fit-step4-s1@0.1.0-draft) rather than a 0.2.0 of the old id
decisions.why: a specific protocol names ONE artifact; the old id names the step-4 s1 TDB, which stays reproducible under its own document

decisions.decision: fit_protocol item 8b (0 K convex hull as low-temperature stability evidence) is not applied to Cr-Ni
decisions.why: 8b postdates the Cr-Ni freeze (1.0.0, 5bede65); the data and objective of the pick stay as frozen
decisions.quote: we dont need the convex hull rule for Cr-Ni

decisions.decision: check10a judged at the 10a pick named by the rule (check10a_ms.py; pick10a.py), not at the label s4_perturbed; global_10c starts from that pick (results/pick10a_start.txt); the step4c_b label checks ([start=s4_perturbed] logpost, topology) moved to check10a; phase_sequence and pure_elements use the 10a pick TDB (tdb/step4c_b_hingefloor_pick10a.tdb) instead of the evaluate.py ranking pick
decisions.why: on spark1 start s4 fell into the flat neighbour mode A2 (1.0.0 rerun, failure 1-2); the pick of this protocol is the 10a pick, which evaluate.py does not compute

decisions.decision: the rerun verdict is judged by predictions only - objective, 10a pick (by rule), topology and phase sequence, eutectic and CrNi2 top, thermochemistry, pure elements and Laplace weight within tolerance; parameters in flat directions, mode and start labels, cache files, timestamps and environment details that do not change predictions are notes; environment pins cover the source files of the code that runs; strict byte checks only for data identity (staged inputs, evidence bundle, evaluated states)
decisions.why: the 1.0.0 spark1 rerun reproduced every prediction but the tool said FAIL
decisions.source: coordinator message 6 Nov 2026 (PI on the 1.0.0 rerun)

decisions.decision: thermochemistry enters the plan as item thermochemistry (per_dataset.py at the 10a pick; thermo_compare.py): every data/thermo dataset of the recorded per_dataset output present with the same number of points and |delta rms_z| <= 0.1; the 10b parameter comparison and the TDB text check stay in results/pick10a_rerun.json as notes
decisions.why: the PI lists thermochemistry among the judged predictions; 0.1 sigma is a tenth of each dataset's own uncertainty, above the 0.022 seen between the A and A2 modes in the 1.0.0 rerun; the staged root holds the data/thermo group only (the oneshot and ZPF groups of per_dataset.py are not staged under those names), so only thermochemistry is judged

decisions.decision: a parameter is undetermined at the 10b tolerance when the two recorded minima of the basin (modes_step4c_b.json, A_s4 and A2_s5_flat) differ by more than its tolerance (here bcc L0/L1 a,b, fcc L0/L1 a,b and CrNi2 b: VV0004-VV0011, VV0013); such parameters are reported, not failed; the other five must lie within 10b
decisions.why: operational reading of the PI rule that flat directions are reported as undetermined; the set comes from recorded data, not from the rerun

decisions.decision: PhaseForge+ source pin = the 9 files under src/ and pyproject.toml (README, tests, examples, .git and caches left out)
decisions.why: the run imports src/ only; pyproject.toml names the package; the 1.0.0 check pinned the full checkout including .pytest_cache and .ruff_cache (failure 4)
